claims.claim: In ChunkStreamBucketEngine.resolveFieldsB, tsCol is overwritten with tsField(*entry) when entry is non-nil and has a non-empty TimestampField, while pkCol resolves to segBPKColumn ('_gpay_id') when both shadow and master have that column.

In TransmuterModule.Run, when chunkIDs is non-empty and lastGpayID is 0, any row in shadowRows with row.Deleted == true has its SourceID appended to deletedInShadow and toHardDelete without checking whether another row in shadowRows for the same SourceID has row.Deleted == false.

In ExecuteHealHandler.executeHealSegB, the PruneMissingSrc branch checks 'if idType == "gpay"' directly on staleB.IDType without auto-detecting gpay IDs when idType is empty, and resolveSourceIDsForSegmentB returns inputIDs unchanged when len(out) == 0.
In ExecuteHealHandler.FetchAndWriteByIDs, nowMs is initialized to time.Now().UnixMilli() and passed to buildHealEnvelope(afterJSON, nowMs), setting source_ts_ms to nowMs for every healed document.

In ReconCore.measureAndResolveWatermarksB, tsCol starts as '_source_ts' and is overwritten by dstTS from resolveSourceAndDestTSFields when entry is found in registryRepo; keeping tsCol as '_source_ts' when both shadow and master have '_source_ts' aligns watermark and window queries on the BIGINT epoch-ms column.

In SchemaAdapter.buildOCCWhereClause, when hasSourceTs and hasPositiveTs are true and _source exists in schema.Columns, the equality branch _source_ts = EXCLUDED._source_ts only permits updates when the existing shadow row has _source = 'snapshot:v2' and EXCLUDED._source <> 'snapshot:v2'.

In TransmuterModule.bulkUpsertMaster, when isFullSync is false, the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE query includes a WHERE clause comparing COALESCE(EXCLUDED._source_ts, 0) >= COALESCE(master._source_ts, 0) - clockSkewToleranceMs.

In the proposed demo for FetchAndWriteByIDs, docTsMs is extracted via servicerecon.ExtractSourceTsFromDoc(doc, entry.TimestampField) and falls back to nowMs only when docTsMs <= 0 before calling buildHealEnvelope(afterJSON, docTsMs).

In the proposed demo for resolveFieldsB, if both e.destAgent.ColumnExists(ctx, shadowRel, "_source_ts") and msAgent.ColumnExists(ctx, masterRel, "_source_ts") return true without error, resolveFieldsB keeps tsCol = "_source_ts" instead of overwriting it with entry.TimestampField.

In the proposed demo for Run and processBatch, a SourceID is appended to deletedInShadow only if !activeSourceIDs[row.SourceID], preventing a historical tombstone row from deleting a newly resurrected active row for the same SourceID.
